answer: Because your car is paid off and the title is lost, you'll need a duplicate title from California before we can complete the purchase, though you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait. To sell, first get an instant offer online with your VIN or license plate (our stores no longer give walk-in quotes), then book an appraisal appointment at a store or, in most states, at your home. A specialist then inspects the car in about 30 minutes and confirms the offer, and finally you sign the paperwork, get paid, and bring everything on the appointment checklist. The help center doesn't cover how to request a California duplicate title, how long it takes, or what's on the checklist, so please contact a store for those details.
